name: 3d-modeling
description: Professional 3D modeling skills for Blender via MCP. Turns modeling from hotkey hints into executable bpy/bmesh construction recipes, adds a goal-to-technique map, a mandatory multi-view visual critique loop, reference-driven & real-scale modeling, and separate hard-surface vs organic topology tracks. Includes the game-ready asset export pipeline (Roblox / UEFN).
